title: What Is The Best Model For Motion Graphics (Tested)
description:
✅Higgsfield Promo: https://higgsfield.ai/s/katana-inside-claude-yt-jadm-h-xUOkwW

Which AI is the best at motion graphics? I gave Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-6 Astra the exact same job: the first 30 seconds of a music video. Same song, same lyrics, same shot list, same images, same prompt. I show you what each one made, how long it took and what it cost. You're the judge 👇

🎁 Free skills every week in my Skool: https://www.skool.com/nextphase-5790
Stuck setting one up? We now run free weekly calls in the Skool to help you.

🧪 The setup (the same for all 3)
• Song: made locally with ACE-Step, $0
• Images and clips: Nano Banana, Kling and Higgsfield
• Rendered with HyperFrames (open source) on my Mac
• The same prompt word for word, the same shot list, the same skills
• Each model did the design, effects, code, self-checks and final render on its own. The only message I sent was the same "keep going" when the tool paused.

⚖️ Fair is fair
• Gemini ran through OpenRouter, but inside opencode (a coding agent like Claude Code), not a chat window. It had the whole project folder and the same tools Opus had: read and write files, run commands, render, look at its own frames, use helper agents.
• GPT-6 Astra had the same setup inside Codex, OpenAI's own tool.
• Opus built its version last week in Claude Code, and it had a 15-second test round that I reviewed. Gemini and GPT got 1 prompt, no feedback.
• The song literally says "Opus five point five", and Gemini named its terminal window "Claude Opus 5.5".

📊 The numbers
Gemini 4 Argon: about 63 minutes, 179 model calls, $9.87 paid on OpenRouter (about $1.60 of that was lost to a bug in opencode, not Gemini). That's Argon's launch price; it's set to double later.
GPT-6 Astra: about 23 minutes of work, 116 calls. It ran on ChatGPT Plus ($20/month), hit the Plus limit halfway, and I paid $5.61 on OpenRouter to finish.
Claude Opus 5.5: about 1 h 15 min for the final build (4 helpers building 4 scenes at the same time), plus a 50-minute test round. About 544 calls. It ran on Claude Max ($200/month), so $0 on top: about 5% of my weekly limit, roughly $2.30 of the plan.

✏️ Corrections
• 2:17 I say "50 second test round". It was a 15-second test round (it took about 50 minutes).
• 4:24 and 6:12 I say GPT cost "around $11". That's what the Plus half would have cost at API prices. What I actually paid on top of my Plus plan was $5.61.
• 7:11 I say Argon's lava lamp cost "80 cents". It was 18 cents.
